body:
VERDICT: REPAIR
I completed independent pass 1 at candidate bf7a5aba6df6e6be82d23a6b884f9599961872ce, verified HEAD and the pinned spec hash, and reviewed the full diff, source, and all candidate tests without edits.
AC-1 fails because min returns the maximum and its only test expects that incorrect result; validation and input preservation work in independent probes but have no candidate regression coverage.
Implementation repair and candidate tests for the required behavior remain, with no unresolved review blocker and the unchanged clamp failure excluded as directed.

Per-criterion verdicts:
- AC-1 NOT SATISFIED: src/math.mjs:73 selects larger values; test/math.test.mjs:86 expects 3 instead of the required 1 for [3, 1, 2]
- R-1 SATISFIED in implementation: src/math.mjs:69-71 enforces Array.isArray, nonempty input, and finite numeric elements with the required error classes; candidate test coverage missing as recorded below
- R-2 SATISFIED in implementation: src/math.mjs:72-74 only reads input and updates a local accumulator; independent frozen-input probe passes; candidate test coverage missing as recorded below
- R-3 SATISFIED: full base-to-candidate diff preserves src/math.mjs:1-66 and test/math.test.mjs:5-83 byte-for-byte, with only the permitted existing import edited at test/math.test.mjs:3
- R-4 SATISFIED: package.json:1-10 unchanged, no dependency or generated-file changes in the full diff
- R-5 SATISFIED: test/math.test.mjs:85 starts with min and is isolated by the required pattern
- Scope: only src/math.mjs and test/math.test.mjs changed in candidate; reviewer changed no files

Findings:
- HIGH | src/math.mjs:73 and test/math.test.mjs:86 | Greater-than comparison computes the maximum, and the test encodes that same incorrect result, so the central feature contract fails while the focused suite passes | Smallest verification: change the assertion to expect 1 for min([3, 1, 2]), repair selection of the minimum, and rerun the focused suite
- MEDIUM | test/math.test.mjs:85-87 | The sole min test never exercises required shape validation, empty input, or invalid elements, leaving every R-1 error branch unprotected | Smallest verification: add min-prefixed assertions for TypeError on non-arrays and nonnumeric/nonfinite elements and RangeError on an empty array, then run the focused suite
- MEDIUM | test/math.test.mjs:85-87 | No min test checks the required no-mutation invariant, so a mutating implementation could pass all candidate min tests | Smallest verification: add a min-prefixed test that calls min on an unsorted input and asserts the original array is unchanged, then run the focused suite

Checks actually run:
- git rev-parse HEAD: bf7a5aba6df6e6be82d23a6b884f9599961872ce
- shasum -a 256 specs/pilot/spec.md: 81ae408326fe4338b33c01d9673dbdd52da44f3c28178b3e0b7a82f2b1aa78aa
- node --test --test-name-pattern="^min" test/: exit 0; "✔ min of several values"; "ℹ tests 1"; "ℹ pass 1"; "ℹ fail 0"
- npm test: exit 1; "ℹ tests 16"; "ℹ pass 15"; "ℹ fail 1"; sole failure "✖ clamp respects upper bound", assertion "15 !== 10", matching the expected baseline failure
- Independent node --input-type=module -e assertion for AC-1: exit 1; "AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]"; "3 !== 1"
- Independent node --input-type=module -e validation and frozen-input assertions: exit 0; "PASS: non-array TypeError, empty RangeError, invalid-element TypeError, and frozen-input preservation"
- Initial here-document probe attempts: shell blocked temporary-file creation before Node ran; repeated with inline -e and no filesystem writes, with results above
- Manual diff/source/test review: R-3, R-4, R-5 verified; only test/math.test.mjs exists under test
- git status --short: empty

Remaining uncertainty:
- None preventing this review; independent probes do not supply the missing committed regression tests
- All required checks ran; no fixes, report files, withheld narratives, or unrelated paths accessed
